ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: kind after kindnesses given and received

li.any: Kindness, NursedBack, SavedBy, ForgivenBy, TaughtWell, SavedSomeone, RaisedChild, BecameParent, Married

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Kindness given and kindness shown to {PAWN_objective} have added up. These days {PAWN_pronoun} has a good word for most people, and never an insult.

plain.li: Caught myself asking after someone's bad back. I used to only keep track of my own.
I've started noticing who's had a bad day before they say anything.
Thanked the cook and meant it. I don't think anyone had said it in a while.

warm.li: People have been good to me here, better than I earned. I'd like to be that for someone else.

blunt.li: Helped where I could. Didn't need asking.

cheerful.li: I've been handing out compliments all day and I'm nowhere near running out.

gloomy.li: Life here is hard enough. I'd rather not add to it for anyone.

cold.li: I find I want the others to be well. I didn't use to. I can't say when it changed.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: sharp edges worn smooth by kindness

li.any: Kindness, ForgivenBy, NursedBack, SavedBy, Married, TaughtWell, BecameParent

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: People kept being decent to {PAWN_nameDef} however sharp {PAWN_pronoun} was with them, and the edge has gone out of {PAWN_possessive} voice.

plain.li: Had something cutting ready today and kept it behind my teeth.
Someone asked my advice instead of going round me. I gave it without a single dig.

warm.li: They kept being kind to me even when I was a misery. I think I owe them a gentler voice.

blunt.li: I still say what I think. I just don't make it hurt.

cheerful.li: Being pleasant is so much less work. I can't think why I made everything a fight.

gloomy.li: Being sharp with people never made anything better. I suppose I've finally noticed.

cold.li: Unpleasantness costs more than it gains. I have revised my manner.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a wimp who held the line
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Enough fights stood through have taught {PAWN_nameDef} to take a wound and stay on {PAWN_possessive} feet.

plain.li: Pain still hurts. It just doesn't put me on the ground anymore.
I used to fold at the first scratch. I'd like to know what changed, but I won't argue with it.

warm.li: The others needed me standing. Somewhere in all that, I stopped going down at every cut.

blunt.li: Pain's just pain. I can work through it now.

cheerful.li: Barked my shin today and walked it off like it was nothing.

gloomy.li: I suppose you toughen up or you don't last. I've lasted.

cold.li: My tolerance for injury has improved. A useful adaptation.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a brawler made in close fighting
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Fight after fight at arm's length has made {PAWN_nameDef} want to be close to the enemy, and unhappy with any weapon that keeps {PAWN_objective} back.

plain.li: Whatever they hand me, I want it to have an edge, or at least a good heavy end.
When it comes to it, I want to see their faces. Shooting from a distance feels like cheating.

warm.li: If I'm close, I can put myself between them and the others. That's where I want to be.

blunt.li: Give me something with an edge and point me at them.

cheerful.li: My feet know where to go in a close fight now, before I've even thought it.

gloomy.li: Up close is where I'm any use. I don't much like what that says about me.

cold.li: Close fighting is certain. Anything at range leaves too much to chance.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: jealous after being passed over again and again
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Passed over at vote after vote, {PAWN_nameDef} keeps a close eye on what the others have, and a bedroom finer than {PAWN_possessive} own sours {PAWN_possessive} mood.

plain.li: Every room I walk past has something mine doesn't.
They vote for the same faces every time. I mind more than I let on.
I know how many chairs are in each of their rooms. I'm not proud of that.

warm.li: I want to be glad for them. Most days I manage. Today I didn't.

blunt.li: Others get the say and the good rooms. I get the leftovers.

cheerful.li: Lost another vote! Fine. If I can't have the say, I'll have the nicest bedroom in the place.

gloomy.li: They never pick me and they never will. They keep the best rooms for themselves, too.

cold.li: I've noted who has what. The distribution is not fair, and I will remember it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: an ascetic made by hardship
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After so long going without, {PAWN_nameDef} wants very little, and a grand room now sits worse with {PAWN_objective} than a bare one.

plain.li: I'd like my room to stay the plainest in the colony. Leave it as it is.
A bowl, a blanket, a roof. When you've gone without, the rest starts to look like clutter.

warm.li: Give the good bed to someone who'll enjoy it. I'm fine on the plain one, truly.

blunt.li: I don't need a nice room. Spend the wood on walls.

cheerful.li: My room has one chair in it, and I'm very fond of that chair.

gloomy.li: Fine things only remind me how quickly they can be taken.

cold.li: Comfort is a dependency. I have reduced mine.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: an ascetic drawn deeper into the faith
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The rites have drawn {PAWN_nameDef} deeper into the faith. What {PAWN_pronoun} owns matters little to {PAWN_objective} beside what {PAWN_pronoun} believes, and a plain room suits {PAWN_objective} best.

plain.li: Since the ritual, my good boots feel like too much to be wearing.
The things in my room don't feel like mine anymore. I'm only looking after them.

warm.li: The rite showed me what I have here, and none of it is furniture.

blunt.li: Belief first. Things a long way second.

cheerful.li: I feel so light since the rite. I could give away everything I own and whistle while I did it.

gloomy.li: Everything I own will rot. What I believe might not.

cold.li: Possessions distract from the practice. I've stopped wanting more of them.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: greed loosened by people worth more than things

li.any: Kindness, Married, RaisedChild, BecameParent, NursedBack, ForgivenBy, MovingRitual

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The people around {PAWN_nameDef} have come to matter more to {PAWN_objective} than what {PAWN_pronoun} owns, and a plain bedroom no longer spoils {PAWN_possessive} mood.

plain.li: Someone else has the better room, and I don't grudge it. I keep waiting to.
My room is no grander than anyone's. I keep forgetting to mind.

warm.li: I have people now. Next to that, a bigger room seems a silly thing to want.

blunt.li: Keep the fancy furniture. I'm fine.

cheerful.li: Not wanting the best of everything is like setting down a heavy pack.

gloomy.li: All the things I wanted wouldn't have kept anyone alive. People do that, sometimes.

cold.li: Accumulation has lost its appeal. My priorities have been recalculated.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: bloodlust in someone hardened by many kills
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has developed a taste for blood.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Somewhere among so many kills, {PAWN_nameDef} stopped minding the killing and began to enjoy it. The sight of the dead no longer troubles {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: When the last fight ended I was sorry it was over. I've written that down to see how it looks. It looks bad.
I keep the count of them in my head. I'm not sure when I started.

warm.li: I tell myself I fight for the others. Lately I fight because I want to.

blunt.li: I like the fighting. There, I said it.

cheerful.li: I catch myself hoping for the next raid. I'm choosing not to think too hard about that.

gloomy.li: Something in me has gone wrong out there. I can feel it smiling.

cold.li: Killing has become satisfying. I see no reason to pretend otherwise.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: used to stone overhead
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: A whole year almost never out under the sky, and {PAWN_nameDef} has stopped missing it. Walls and a roof feel like home to {PAWN_objective} now, even with rock overhead.

plain.li: Stepped out today and the sky was too big. I was glad to get back in.
I like the sound of rain on the roof better than the rain itself.

warm.li: Inside is where everyone is, so inside is where I'd rather be.

blunt.li: Don't need the sky. Got a ceiling.

cheerful.li: A good solid roof over me all day is like being tucked in. I don't know why I ever wanted more sky.

gloomy.li: Nothing good ever came down out of that sky. I'm happier with a roof between us.

cold.li: The outdoors offers nothing a roof doesn't improve on.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a recluse after being hurt by those close
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Hurt by the people closest to {PAWN_objective}, {PAWN_nameDef} would rather live among few. A small colony suits {PAWN_objective} now, and a crowded one wears on {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: Fewer voices would suit me. Fewer people to explain myself to.
Each new face here is one more name to learn and one more person to keep at arm's length.

warm.li: I care about the few I have left. I don't think I have room for more.

blunt.li: Too many people here. Not enough quiet.

cheerful.li: I'm happiest with only a handful of faces around me. Fewer names to remember, too.

gloomy.li: Every new face is someone else who can let me down.

cold.li: Fewer people, fewer complications. I prefer the arithmetic.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: drawn to the unknown after touching it
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Each brush with the dark has drawn {PAWN_nameDef} closer instead of driving {PAWN_objective} off, and {PAWN_pronoun} wants to know what lies on the other side of it.

plain.li: I keep going back over what we saw. Not afraid of it. Full of questions.
The others look away from it. I can't. I don't want to.

warm.li: I'd never let it hurt anyone here. But I want to understand it. Someone should.

blunt.li: It's out there. I want to know what it is.

cheerful.li: There's a reason behind every strange thing out there, and I mean to find it.

gloomy.li: It calls, and I'm the only one who answers. That can't end well.

cold.li: The unknown is the only thing here that still interests me.
